The frequency-conditioned model reproduces matrix elements to below 1 meV on the imaginary axis for the systems studied here, and that accuracy survives the continuation: for water clusters, including a tetramer absent from the training set, and for chemically diverse molecules from QM9, the reconstructed spectral functions follow the G_0W_0 reference peak by peak and the frontier quasiparticle levels are recovered to a few tens of meV. Learning the self-energy on the imaginary axis is therefore a practical route to real-frequency spectra: once the model is trained, and given the density-functional reference it is built on, a new geometry costs no explicit G_0W_0 calculation.

AI.tldr: 该工作用E(3)等变消息传递网络从原子种类和坐标预测分子在虚频轴上的G_0W_0自能动力学关联矩阵，并将预测结果解析延拓到实频轴，从而免去对新几何显式计算G_0W_0即可获得谱函数和准粒子能级。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理计算自能成本高，且自能是复值、局域轨道基下的矩阵值并连续依赖频率，是困难的机器学习目标；作者希望学习虚频自能并可靠延拓到实频，以高效获得准粒子谱。
AI.method: 以密度泛函参考的静态交换部分为基础，仅学习G_0W_0自能的动力学关联部分；采用E(3)等变消息传递网络，由架构保证轨道空间矩阵的旋转协变；频率作为显式网络输入或通过频率特定输出头处理；预测的虚频矩阵在一种保证因果性和非负谱密度的表示下延拓到实轴。
AI.result: 频率条件模型在虚频轴上对研究体系的矩阵元误差低于1 meV；延拓后，对水团簇（包括训练集外的四聚体）和QM9中化学多样性分子，重构谱函数逐峰吻合G_0W_0参考，前沿准粒子能级恢复误差为几十meV。
AI.conclusion: 在虚频轴学习自能量是通向实频谱的实用路线：模型训练完成后，结合其依赖的密度泛函参考，新几何无需显式G_0W_0计算即可预测谱性质。

title: Intercalation of Ultrathin Ferromagnetic Iron Films at the Graphene/SiC Interface
summary: The intercalation of high-quality PASG-grown (polymer-assisted sublimation growth) zero-layer graphene on 4H-SiC(0001) with iron is studied using a deposition-and-annealing approach. We find that unlike other metals, Fe does not easily intercalate, and the intercalation procedure has to be balanced with the formation of iron silicides and graphitic carbon at the interface. After successful intercalation, the ultrathin iron films are protected against oxidation by the covering graphene sheet, and retain ferromagnetic behaviour with an in-plane easy axis even at room temperature. When exposed to a selenium-rich atmosphere at elevated temperatures, an almost complete exchange of Fe by Se is observed, imposing a major restriction for the formation of multi-element 2D compounds via sequential intercalation schemes.

AI.tldr: 研究了PASG生长的高质量零层石墨烯/4H-SiC(0001)体系中Fe的插层行为、稳定性及后续Se交换，发现Fe插层受硅化物和石墨碳形成制约，但成功插层后可被石墨烯保护并保持室温铁磁性。
AI.motivation: 探究Fe能否像其他金属一样插入石墨烯与4H-SiC界面，并评估插层后超薄Fe膜的环境稳定性、磁性与后续元素交换可行性，以判断顺序插层构建多元素二维化合物的潜力。
AI.method: 采用沉积-退火方法在PASG生长的零层石墨烯/4H-SiC(0001)上进行Fe插层，并分析插层过程与界面反应；随后在富Se气氛和高温条件下考察Fe的交换行为。
AI.result: Fe不像其他金属那样容易插层，插层工艺需与界面处铁硅化物和石墨碳的形成相平衡。成功插层后，超薄Fe膜受覆盖石墨烯保护而抗氧化，并保留面内易轴的铁磁行为直至室温。在富Se气氛和高温下，Fe几乎被Se完全交换。
AI.conclusion: Fe插层可实现且所得超薄Fe膜受石墨烯保护并具室温铁磁性，但Fe向Se的近完全交换表明顺序插层方案在构建多元素二维化合物方面存在重要限制。

title: Analysis of Transient Microscopy Data in Reciprocal Space
summary: Transient microscopy has evolved to include a family of well-established techniques for studying the spatiotemporal dynamics of excited states in a variety of materials systems. In these methods, a laser pulse is focused to locally excite a material, and the subsequent evolution of the excited species is visualized to extract transport parameters such as diffusivities. Typically, transport coefficients are extracted from experimental datasets using curve-fitting methods to analyze the change in the mean squared displacement (MSD) of the spatial profiles over time. However, this approach can lead to inaccurate or misleading diffusivity values under many common experimental conditions, and is only formally accurate for the case of a single diffusing species. In this work, we introduce a new approach to the analysis of transient microscopy data based on the evolution of profile shapes in reciprocal space. We use simulated datasets to quantitatively analyze the performance of our proposed methods and compare them to current state-of-the-art analysis techniques. We demonstrate that reciprocal-space-based analysis methods have the highest overall performance in terms of accuracy and precision for normal diffusive transport over a range of realistic initial conditions and signal-to-noise ratios. Furthermore, we highlight the limitations of using MSD alone to characterize anomalous transport in materials, and we show how analysis of spatial frequencies can yield a more comprehensive understanding of complex excited-state dynamics and their underlying physical mechanisms. Our results show that reciprocal-space-based analysis methods are powerful tools for characterizing and quantifying many different types of transport behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于倒空间（空间频率）瞬态显微数据分析的新方法，用于提取激发态输运参数；模拟对比表明其在正常扩散中总体准确度和精度最高，并能更好刻画反常输运。
AI.motivation: 传统方法通过拟合空间分布均方位移（MSD）随时间变化提取扩散系数，但在常见实验条件下可能产生不准确或误导性的扩散率，且形式上仅适用于单一扩散物种。
AI.method: 作者利用模拟数据集，比较基于倒空间中分布形状演化的分析方法与现有先进分析技术，并在多种现实初始条件和信噪比下评估性能；同时分析空间频率以研究复杂激发态动力学，并讨论仅用MSD表征反常输运的局限。
AI.result: 倒空间分析方法在正常扩散输运中于准确度和精度上总体表现最佳；仅依赖MSD不足以表征材料中的反常输运，而空间频率分析可更全面地理解复杂激发态动力学及其物理机制。
AI.conclusion: 基于倒空间的分析方法是表征和量化多种输运行为的强有力工具。

title: Ionic switching between supermagnetic states
summary: Supermagnetic states are typically set during synthesis. Changing and retaining these states requires sustained external stimulus. Without resynthesis or continued stimulus, we show, for the first time, a reversible magneto-ionic switching between superferromagnetic (SFM) and superspin-glass (SSG) states using room-temperature Li-ion transport. We utilize the incomplete lithiation of NiO into nanoscale Ni and Li2O to switch between the states. Lithiation generates a fragmented nano-Ni network that strengthens dipolar interactions and promotes SFM order with stronger memory and higher room-temperature moments. Delithiation partially regenerates NiO and drives the system into an SSG state with higher low-temperature coercivity and sharper temperature-selective memory. The interconversion between SFM and SSG persists at all measured subsequent lithiation-delithiation cycles, creating a general framework for supermagnetic switching.

AI.tldr: 作者首次展示了一种无需持续外场、可在室温通过Li离子输运实现超铁磁（SFM）与超自旋玻璃（SSG）之间可逆磁离子切换的方法。
AI.motivation: 超磁态通常在材料合成时确定，若要改变或保持这些状态需要持续外部刺激；研究旨在不重新合成、不依赖持续刺激的情况下实现超磁态的可逆切换与保持。
AI.method: 利用室温Li离子输运对NiO进行不完全锂化/脱锂：锂化生成纳米Ni与Li2O，脱锂部分再生NiO，并据此调控纳米Ni网络及偶极相互作用，从而切换SFM与SSG态。
AI.result: 锂化形成碎片化纳米Ni网络，增强偶极相互作用并促进SFM有序，表现为更强记忆效应和更高室温磁矩；脱锂部分再生NiO并驱动体系进入SSG态，表现更高低温矫顽力和更尖锐的温度选择性记忆。SFM与SSG之间的相互转换在后续所有锂化-脱锂循环中均保持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于磁离子效应的超磁态可逆切换通用框架，证明超磁态可在室温下通过Li离子输运进行非合成式、可循环调控。

title: A Physics-based and Geometry-aware Reduced-order Framework for Accelerated Part-Scale Thermomechanical Simulation of Additive Friction Stir Deposition Process
summary: Additive friction stir deposition (AFSD) is attractive for naval and aerospace sustainment because it enables high rate, solid state near net shape fabrication and repair of large metallic components. However, full part scale thermomechanical simulations remain computationally demanding because of the moving heat source, progressive material deposition, and evolving geometry. This work presents a physics-based and geometry-aware reduced order framework for rapid prediction of temperature and residual stress fields in part scale AFSD builds. The transient temperature field is represented using a tensor product quadratic B spline basis on a fixed Cartesian background grid, while arbitrary part geometries are embedded using a signed distance function (SDF) and a smooth material indicator. Residual stresses are recovered through an inherent strain formulation in which an offline thermo elasto plastic representative volume element (RVE) simulation supplies a calibrated eigenstrain field that is spatially scaled using the part scale peak temperature history. The thermal formulation is evaluated against published numerical and experimental AFSD data and two sample multilayer builds are simulated as demonstrations. For a four layer thin-wall build, the thermal solution requires approximately 22 s compared to 806 s for the finite element model, while the complete thermo-mechanical framework requires approximately 86.4 s compared to 2,406 s. For a larger 20 layer hollow cylindrical build, the reduced order thermal simulations requires 0.148 to 0.152 h compared with 1.8 h for the finite element model, corresponding to thermal speed-ups of approximately 11.8 to 12.2 times. The complete thermomechanical framework requires 0.346 h compared to 5.4 h for the full finite element analysis, providing an overall speed-up of approximately 15.6 times.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于物理且几何感知的降阶框架，用于快速预测零件尺度增材摩擦搅拌沉积（AFSD）的温度场和残余应力场。
AI.motivation: AFSD适合大型金属构件的高速固态近净成形与修复，但全零件尺度热力学仿真因移动热源、逐层材料沉积和几何演化而计算成本高。
AI.method: 瞬态温度场在固定笛卡尔背景网格上用张量积二次B样条基表示，任意零件几何通过符号距离函数（SDF）和平滑材料指示函数嵌入；残余应力采用固有应变法，由离线热弹塑性代表体积元（RVE）模拟标定特征应变，并依据零件尺度峰值温度历史进行空间缩放；热学公式与已发表数值和实验AFSD数据对比，并模拟两个多层构件示例。
AI.result: 四层薄壁构件热解约22 s（有限元806 s），完整热力框架约86.4 s（有限元2406 s）；20层空心圆柱构件热解0.148–0.152 h（有限元1.8 h），热学加速约11.8–12.2倍，完整热力框架0.346 h（有限元5.4 h），总体加速约15.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 该降阶框架在保持物理基础和几何感知的同时显著加速零件尺度AFSD热力预测，适用于大型金属构件的增材制造与修复分析。

title: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb$_4$Se$_8$
summary: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb$_4$Se$_8$, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究以层状交错磁体CoNb₄Se₈为例，结合微区ARPES与DFT表明解理面共存Co终止和Se终止微区，其各自表面态会干扰对体相自旋劈裂带的识别，因此可靠判定交错磁性必须考虑终止依赖的表面贡献。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体具有零净磁化下的对称性 enforced 自旋劈裂能带，ARPES可直接探测其电子结构；但ARPES表面敏感，表面态易被误判为体相自旋劈裂对应特征，层状插层材料解理面上不同终止的微米级畴共存使该问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 针对最早确立的层状交错磁体之一CoNb₄Se₈，使用微区ARPES对解理面上单个微米级畴进行探测，并结合密度泛函理论计算分析不同表面终止及其表面态来源。
AI.result: 识别出Co终止与Se终止两类对比明显的表面畴，并发现它们具有由体相-表面连通性产生的特征表面态；这些终止依赖表面态会影响对自旋劈裂体相能带的谱学指认。
AI.conclusion: 层状交错磁体的ARPES识别必须区分终止依赖的表面态与体相自旋劈裂信号；考虑表面终止效应对于可靠确认交错磁性及评估其在层状材料家族中的存在至关重要。

title: Active Learning for Interatomic Potentials: A Review of Uncertainty-Driven Data Efficiency
summary: Developing a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) that is accurate for the specific conditions under which it will be applied, rather than simply for the predefined configurations chosen by the model developer, is a significant challenge in atomistic simulation. Active learning (AL) addresses this challenge by closing the loop between candidate generation, data selection, reference calculation, and model updating. Here, we survey more than seventy studies, with an emphasis on work from 2020 to 2026, to understand how active learning has evolved from a niche, on-the-fly training technique for query-by-committee and Gaussian process force fields into a diverse family of data-efficient strategies. he reviewed examples include on-the-fly molecular dynamics, active data selection for fine-tuning pretrained models, kernel- and representation-based acquisition using frozen pretrained models, and reaction-aware sampling for chemical systems far from equilibrium. We explore the use of active learning in elemental and alloy mechanics, hydrogen and ion diffusion, ferroelectrics and effective Hamiltonians of functional materials, reactive and photochemical dynamics, high-entropy and compositionally disordered materials, as well as generative and autonomous material discovery pipelines. Drawing on a growing body of critical, methodologically self-aware literature, we also show that this achievement carries systematic caveats. Uncertainty estimates are not interchangeable across model architectures and are frequently the least reliable exactly where they matter most. We close by discussing the outlook for standardized, uncertainty-calibrated, and observable-targeted active-learning workflows in the foundation-model era.

AI.tldr: 该文综述了70余项研究（重点2020—2026年），梳理主动学习（AL）如何从面向query-by-committee和高斯过程力场的on-the-fly训练技术，发展为面向机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的多样化数据高效策略。
AI.motivation: MLIP应针对实际应用条件保持准确，而非仅拟合开发者预设构型；AL通过闭环连接候选构型生成、数据选择、参考计算和模型更新，以提升数据效率并覆盖应用相关构型空间。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法，归纳AL在on-the-fly分子动力学、预训练模型微调的主动数据选择、基于冻结预训练模型的核/表示采集，以及远离平衡化学体系的反应感知采样等策略；并覆盖合金力学、氢/离子扩散、铁电体与有效哈密顿量、反应/光化学动力学、高熵与成分无序材料及生成式/自主材料发现流程。
AI.result: AL已形成多样化的数据高效方法族并在多类材料与化学体系中应用；但综述指出系统性局限：不同模型架构间的不确定性估计不可互换，且往往在最关键区域最不可靠。
AI.conclusion: AL是提升MLIP应用相关准确性的有效闭环范式，但需发展标准化、不确定性校准且面向可观测目标的主动学习工作流，以适应基础模型时代。

title: Magnetic flux ring splitting near a Navier-Stokes singularity
summary: OpenAI reports a forced Navier-Stokes flow that becomes singular in finite time, raising the question of its physical consequences. Magnetic reconnection offers a test through the splitting and merging of flux structures. We use resistive magnetohydrodynamics to simulate a magnetic ring driven by an imposed, regularized flow that reproduces the geometry and scaling of the collapsing core. At the nominal singular time, we remove the imposed drive and allow the system to evolve freely. Reconnections before and after release split the ring into two or more daughter rings through bifurcations of the poloidal flux function, with Lorentz feedback selecting the bifurcation type. Unequal winding by the swirl above and below the midplane produces asymmetric toroidal magnetic stresses, unfolding the kinematic pitchfork-like transition into a fold. For single-island splits, the cusp normal form predicts the asymmetry of the daughter rings without adjustable parameters. Three-dimensional simulations retain the splits and merger, confirming that approach to hydrodynamic blow-up can trigger magnetic restructuring.

AI.tldr: 利用电阻磁流体力学模拟受迫Navier-Stokes奇点附近的磁环演化，发现接近有限时间爆破可触发磁重联，使磁环分裂或合并并产生可预测的不对称结构。
AI.motivation: OpenAI报告的有限时间奇异Navier-Stokes流的物理后果尚不明确；磁重联可通过磁通结构的劈裂与合并检验奇点逼近对磁场的影响。
AI.method: 采用电阻磁流体力学模拟磁环，施加正则化强迫流以复现坍缩核的几何与标度；在名义奇异时刻撤去驱动并允许系统自由演化；分析释放前后的重联、极向磁通函数分岔及洛伦兹反馈，并用三维模拟验证。
AI.result: 释放前后重联将磁环分裂为两个或多个子环，洛伦兹反馈选择分岔类型；上下旋涡不等绕转产生不对称环向磁应力，将运动学叉式分岔展开为折叠；单岛分裂时尖点正规形无需可调参数即可预测子环不对称；三维模拟保留分裂与合并。
AI.conclusion: 接近流体动力学爆破可触发磁重构，表明Navier-Stokes奇点具有可观测磁效应，并为重联分岔提供定量描述。

title: Topological Magnetism in 2D and 3D: Skyrmions and Hopfions. Classical and quantum approaches
summary: We discuss the properties of ferromagnetic skyrmions in relation to the Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction, nonlinear sigma models, merons, vortices, frustration, and dipole dipole interactions. Particular attention is given to skyrmion skyrmion interactions and to the dynamical equations governing magnetic textures, including the Landau Lifshitz Gilbert, Thiele, and Landau Lifshitz Bloch equations. The review subsequently extends the discussion to antiferromagnetic systems and to topological structures in three dimensions, with emphasis on Hopfions and their topological characterization. We then examine quantum skyrmions, including approaches that go beyond the semiclassical description, and discuss the emergence of quantum Hopfions. The theoretical framework is complemented by appendices presenting analytical solutions and ansatzes for skyrmions, spin coherent states and path integrals, quantum antiferromagnets, spin torques, fiber-bundle concepts and the Hopf map, and the Euler Lagrange formalism in three dimensions. By connecting continuum field theory, magnetic dynamics, topology, and quantum mechanics, this review aims to provide a coherent framework for understanding the formation, stability, dynamics, interactions, and quantum properties of topological magnetic textures across different dimensions and magnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 该文综述拓扑磁性织构：铁磁与反铁磁 skyrmions、merons/vortices、三维 Hopfions 及量子 skyrmions/quantum Hopfions，并连接连续场论、磁动力学、拓扑与量子力学。
AI.motivation: 旨在为不同维度和不同磁性体系中拓扑磁织构的形成、稳定性、动力学、相互作用与量子性质建立统一、连贯的理论框架。
AI.method: 以综述方式讨论 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、非线性 sigma 模型、阻挫与偶极相互作用；重点分析 skyrmion-skyrmion 相互作用及 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert、Thiele、Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch 方程；扩展至反铁磁系统、三维 Hopfions 的拓扑表征和超越半经典描述的量子 skyrmions/quantum Hopfions；附录给出解析解与 ansatz、自旋相干态与路径积分、量子反铁磁体、自旋力矩、纤维丛与 Hopf 映射、三维 Euler-Lagrange 形式。
AI.result: 系统整合了 skyrmions 与 Hopfions 等拓扑磁织构的连续场论描述、磁动力学方程、拓扑分类及量子处理方法，并补充了相关解析与数学工具。
AI.conclusion: 通过连接连续场论、磁动力学、拓扑和量子力学，该综述为理解跨维度、跨磁性体系的拓扑磁织构提供了连贯的理论框架。

title: Crystal Field-Phonon Coupling in ErFeO$_3$ Single Crystal Via Inelastic Neutron Scattering
summary: Crystal-field (CF) excitations and their coupling to lattice vibrations were investigated in ErFeO$_3$ using inelastic neutron scattering. Pronounced modifications of the excitation spectra, including energy shifts, intensity redistribution, and linewidth changes, were observed as a consequence of CF-phonon coupling. Significant renormalization of the first and second CF excitations, located near 5 meV and 12 meV, respectively, was detected along both transverse and longitudinal directions in the vicinity of the reciprocal-space point Q = (2, 0, 4). The coupling effects become more prominent as the temperature increases from 300 K to 650 K, while a slight suppression is observed at 750 K. Remarkably, CF excitation peaks that are strongly weakened by thermal population effects re-emerge in specific momentum regions through interaction with phonon modes. The coupled excitations exhibit characteristic signatures of hybridization, including energy renormalization, intensity enhancement, and linewidth narrowing. Density-functional-theory-based phonon calculations further support the interpretation of CF-phonon coupling in ErFeO3. These results demonstrate that strong interactions between CF excitations and lattice vibrations can substantially modify the excitation spectra in rare-earth orthoferrites.

AI.tldr: 该文利用非弹性中子散射研究ErFeO3中晶体场激发及其与晶格振动的耦合，发现强CF-声子耦合导致激发谱显著重整，并得到DFT声子计算支持。
AI.motivation: 稀土正铁氧体中晶体场激发与晶格振动的相互作用可能显著改变激发谱，但对其温度、动量依赖及杂化特征仍需深入理解。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射测量ErFeO3的晶体场激发，沿横/纵向在Q=(2,0,4)附近考察约5 meV和12 meV的前两个CF激发，温度范围300–750 K；并结合基于密度泛函理论的声子计算进行解释。
AI.result: 观察到能量移动、强度重分布和线宽变化；第一、第二CF激发在Q=(2,0,4)附近发生显著重整；耦合效应随温度从300 K升至650 K增强，750 K略有抑制；热布居削弱的CF峰在特定动量区因与声子模相互作用而再出现；杂化表现为能量重整、强度增强和线宽变窄。
AI.conclusion: CF激发与晶格振动之间的强相互作用可显著改稀土正铁氧体的激发谱，表明CF-声子耦合是理解其激发动力学的重要因素。

title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard. A live record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians
summary: In condensed matter physics, scientists explore phase diagrams of matter through various methods (analysis, numerics, experiment) and achieve consensus when enough methods agree. The quality of variational results for quantum many-body ground states is mainly judged by energy values and respective errors. Here, we present QMBL, the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard (https://www.qmbl.org), serving as the energy layer of the scientific consensus. It is a maintained, interactive record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. The latest release v0.4.0 holds 1434 energies on 395 instances of six model families and collects all of the community's efforts into one view. Of those instances 153 have no exact solution and any new record serves as a direct improvement to an open science problem. They are the targets of a companion benchmark, QMBL: Open Problems.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍 QMBL——量子多体排行榜，作为格点哈密顿量基态能量的科学共识层，汇总已发表基态能量并识别开放问题。
AI.motivation: 凝聚态物理中相图结论依赖多种方法趋同；变分基态结果主要以能量值及误差评判，因此需要一个持续维护、可交互的已发表基态能量记录来支撑共识与基准测试。
AI.method: 构建 QMBL（https://www.qmbl.org），作为能量层的交互式排行榜，持续收集并整合格点哈密顿量的已发表基态能量；配套 QMBL: Open Problems 基准聚焦无精确解实例。
AI.result: 最新 v0.4.0 收录 6 个模型族、395 个实例的 1434 个能量；其中 153 个实例无精确解，任何新纪录都直接改进开放科学问题。
AI.conclusion: QMBL 将社区结果集中呈现，为量子多体基态能量提供共识记录，并通过开放问题基准推动无精确解实例的改进。

title: Probing nonequilibrium transport and density profiles in tilted interacting fermion chains with local reservoirs
summary: We investigate how local particle reservoirs can probe transport and density profiles in tilted spinless fermion chains with nearest-neighbor interactions. Using finite-chain Lindblad calculations with particle injection and extraction at opposite ends, we define a threshold-dependent transmission range from the stationary current as the chain length is varied. This range decreases with increasing tilt and follows the trends of the equilibrium density-crossover width in the parameter regimes studied. Interactions can enhance transmission by compensating field-induced energy costs, whereas strongly polarized configurations suppress transport. A third, weakly coupled extraction reservoir provides a complementary spatial probe: its current is exactly proportional to the local occupation in the presence of the probe, and the normalized current approaches the unperturbed nonequilibrium density as the probe coupling vanishes. We illustrate the detection of staggered density modulations and show that bulk densities can continue to relax after boundary currents have nearly stabilized. These protocols connect current measurements to spatial transmission and density structure in driven interacting chains.

AI.tldr: 研究倾斜无自旋费米链中局部粒子库如何探测输运与密度分布；用Lindblad有限链模拟定义阈值相关透射范围，并展示弱耦合探针电流可映射局域密度。
AI.motivation: 理解驱动相互作用量子链中边界电流与体密度结构的关系，以及倾斜场和相互作用如何影响传输范围。
AI.method: 采用有限链Lindblad主方程，在两端进行粒子注入与抽取；由稳态电流随链长变化定义阈值相关透射范围；并引入弱耦合第三抽取库作为空间探针。
AI.result: 透射范围随倾斜增大而减小，并与平衡密度交叉宽度趋势一致；相互作用可通过补偿场致能量代价增强传输，强极化构型则抑制传输；探针电流与局域占据成正比，弱耦合极限下归一化电流趋于未扰动非平衡密度；可检测交错密度调制，且边界电流近稳后体密度仍可继续弛豫。
AI.conclusion: 局域粒子库协议将电流测量与驱动相互作用链的空间透射及密度结构联系起来，可用于探测非平衡密度分布和弛豫。

title: Anyon bound states in MoTe$_2$ Fractional Chern Insulators
summary: Binding anyons to optically active excitons offers a route to manipulate fractional excitations and reveal the internal spatial structure of anyons. We establish the formation of anyon bound states between a mobile dipolar exciton and an $e/3$ quasihole in a twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ fractional Chern insulator. Using exact diagonalization of a continuum-based interacting model, we identify a regime of meV-scale binding and strong exciton-quasihole entanglement controlled by exciton mobility and the distance between the exciton and the FCI. Spatial correlations resolve a localized depletion core carrying approximately $e/3$ charge around the exciton, providing a real-space characterization of the bound state. Beyond its fractional charge, the quasihole exhibits a moir\'e-induced octupolar structure. Interlayer tunneling anisotropy strongly deforms this structure while leaving the enclosed charge nearly unchanged, linking the internal profile of the anyon to the underlying electronic quantum geometry. These findings establish conditions for robust exciton-anyon binding in moir\'e heterostructures and show how these composites provide access to properties of fractional excitations beyond their total charge.

AI.tldr: 该文在连续模型精确对角化框架下预言：在扭转双层MoTe₂分数陈绝缘体中，可移动偶极激子可与e/3准空穴形成MeV量级的任意子束缚态，并可通过激子-准空穴纠缠与实空间关联刻画其内部结构。
AI.motivation: 将任意子与光活性激子束缚，有望操控分数激发并探测任意子的内部空间结构，而不仅限于其总分数电荷。
AI.method: 采用基于连续介质的相互作用模型并进行精确对角化，研究偶极激子与e/3准空穴在扭转双层MoTe₂分数陈绝缘体中的结合；通过空间关联函数分析束缚态电荷分布，并考察激子迁移率、激子与FCI距离及层间隧穿各向异性的影响。
AI.result: 发现MeV量级结合能与强激子-准空穴纠缠，且受激子迁移率和激子-FCI距离调控；空间关联显示激子周围存在约e/3电荷的局域耗尽核；准空穴具有莫尔诱导的八极结构，层间隧穿各向异性可强烈改变该内部结构而几乎不改变包围电荷。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了莫尔异质结中稳健激子-任意子束缚的条件，并表明此类复合体可访问分数激发除总电荷之外的内部性质，将任意子内部轮廓与电子量子几何联系起来。

title: Fractional Chern insulators and composite Fermi liquids vs. charge order in twisted MoTe$_2$
summary: The bandstructure of twisted MoTe$_2$ around 3.7$^\circ$ consists of spin-valley locked Chern bands with a bandwidth that is smaller than the interaction scale. As such, the strongly correlated phases familiar from Landau levels can be realized: Quantum Hall states, composite Fermi liquids and charge order. These states have in common that they are all favoured by strong interactions, however changing the quantum geometry and topology of the bands as well as their bandwidth via the displacement field and twist angle tilts the balance between them. We provide a comprehensive exact diagonalization analysis of the competition between these states and in particular elucidate the nature of the charge order at fillings $\nu=-\frac14,-\frac13,-\frac12,-\frac23$. Furthermore, we analyze the effect of band mixing by going beyond a single band per valley. This effect of band mixing is crucial for reconciling the numerical phase diagrams with experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究了约3.7°扭转MoTe2中自旋-谷锁定的陈能带在强相互作用下量子霍尔态、复合费米液体与电荷序之间的竞争，并强调能带混合对解释实验相图至关重要。
AI.motivation: 扭转MoTe2在3.7°附近具有带宽小于相互作用尺度的自旋-谷锁定陈能带，可承载类朗道能级的强关联相；但位移场和扭角会改变量子几何、拓扑与带宽，从而调节这些强关联态之间的平衡，且单能带近似可能不足以解释实验。
AI.method: 采用综合的精确对角化分析，研究填充ν=-1/4、-1/3、-1/2、-2/3处电荷序的性质及其与量子霍尔态和复合费米液体的竞争；并超越每谷单能带近似，引入能带混合效应。
AI.result: 揭示了不同填充下电荷序的细节及强关联相之间的竞争关系；发现能带混合对将数值相图与实验观测相协调起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 扭转MoTe2中的强关联相竞争受能带几何、拓扑、带宽及能带混合共同控制；要合理解释实验相图，必须考虑每谷多能带效应。

title: Bulk-Defect Correspondence in Algebraic Classical Spin Liquids
summary: Local constraints in algebraic classical spin liquids give rise to singular momentum-space correlations. This so called pinch-point singularity carries a momentum-space winding number that determines the low-energy structure of the algebraic spin liquid. We show that nonmagnetic vacancies in two dimensions reveal this topological invariant in the real-space winding of the surrounding spin textures. Under explicit conditions, we prove this bulk-defect correspondence for rank-$n$ $\mathrm{U}(1)$ spin liquids and verify it numerically for the Coulomb spin liquids of the kagome and checkerboard lattices and the rank-2 $\mathrm{U}(1)$ spin liquid of the honeycomb-snowflake model. In this way we show that vacancies can be used as general probes for distinguishing the emergent gauge theories of strongly correlated classical disordered magnets.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示二维非磁性空位可通过周围自旋织构的实空间绕数探测代数经典自旋液体中由 pinch-point 奇异性携带的动量空间绕数，并建立 rank-n U(1) 自旋液体的体-缺陷对应。
AI.motivation: 代数经典自旋液体的低能结构由 pinch-point 奇异性及其动量空间绕数决定，但如何用实空间可观测缺陷区分不同涌现规范理论仍待解决。
AI.method: 在明确条件下证明 rank-n U(1) 自旋液体的体-缺陷对应，并对 kagome、checkerboard 格子的 Coulomb 自旋液体及 honeycomb-snowflake 模型的 rank-2 U(1) 自旋液体进行数值验证。
AI.result: 非磁性空位周围自旋织构的实空间绕数可显露动量空间拓扑不变量，数值结果支持该 bulk-defect correspondence 在多种二维自旋液体中成立。
AI.conclusion: 空位可作为通用探针，用于区分强关联经典无序磁体的涌现规范理论。

authors: N. N. S. V. Rama Raju
title: Coexistence of Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like behavior in La-doped antiferromagnetic CaMnO3
summary: The coexistence of a Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like short range interaction in a single-phase homogeneous manganite is of particular interest because it reveals multiple levels of magnetic clustering generated by disorder and competing exchange interactions. In bulk $\mathrm{La}_{0.19}\mathrm{Ca}_{0.81}\mathrm{MnO}_{3}$, this unusual magnetic state develops in the antiferromagnetic regime, where A-site disorder strongly modifies the local magnetic landscape. Rietveld analysis confirms a single-phase orthorhombic structure, while magnetic measurements establish a Griffiths phase below $T_{\mathrm{G}} = 280\text{ K}$ through the deviation from Curie-Weiss behavior. Superparamagnetic-like behavior persisting from 280 to 370 K further indicates that isolated magnetic clusters remain stable well into the nominally paramagnetic region. The presence of both phenomena highlights the crucial role of disorder-induced exchange randomness in stabilizing complex magnetic states in correlated perovskite oxides.

AI.tldr: 在单相正交结构La0.19Ca0.81MnO3中，观察到Griffiths相与超顺磁样短程相互作用共存，表明A位无序和竞争交换作用可在反铁磁区诱导多级磁团簇。
AI.motivation: 研究单相均匀锰氧化物中Griffiths相与超顺磁样行为的共存，以揭示无序和竞争交换作用如何产生多层次磁团簇，并稳定关联钙钛矿氧化物中的复杂磁态。
AI.method: 采用Rietveld精修确认样品为单相正交结构；通过磁化测量分析偏离Curie-Weiss行为，确定Griffiths相转变温度TG=280 K，并考察280–370 K范围内的超顺磁样行为。
AI.result: Rietveld分析表明样品为单相正交结构；磁测量显示在TG=280 K以下偏离Curie-Weiss定律并形成Griffiths相；280–370 K持续存在超顺磁样行为，说明孤立磁团簇在名义顺磁区仍稳定存在。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明A位无序引起的交换随机性可在反铁磁背景中稳定Griffiths相和超顺磁样磁团簇，凸显无序调控在关联钙钛矿氧化物复杂磁态形成中的关键作用。

title: Kitaev, semi-Dirac, and spinon quantum spin Hall liquids on the square-hexagon-dodecagon lattice: A parent projective symmetry group classification
summary: The square-hexagon-dodecagon (SHD) lattice hosts an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid, while further-neighbor couplings frustrate its Heisenberg magnet into classically degenerate lines where quantum fluctuations can melt the N\'eel order. To place this state among the lattice's spin liquids, we classify fermionic parton mean-field states with singlet and spin-orbit-coupled triplet amplitudes by their projective symmetry groups (PSGs). As SHD sites lack site symmetry, its $Z_2$ PSGs are the projective classes of $p6mm$ with time reversal, from which those of every single-orbit $p6mm$ lattice follow. In the idealized Kitaev model, where lattice operations do not rotate spins, these liquids carry a single $Z_2$ PSG descending from the $SU(2)$ Lieb-flux state, and their projections are exact eigenstates. The PSG's sixfold-rotation sign, fixed by the dodecagon flux, doubles all Majorana bands, and the mirrors exclude a chiral phase in any uniform field, so only a sublattice-staggered three-spin term drives the non-Abelian Ising phase. Beyond the Kitaev state, we find a critical semi-Dirac spin liquid, with mean-field correlations $\propto r^{-3}$ along three directions and $r^{-6}$ otherwise, and extended Dirac phases with up to $48$ fermion flavors, among them an $N_f=12$ state whose PSG forbids every singlet mass. Out-of-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya couplings gap the Dirac states of its $U(1)$ class into a mean-field spinon counterpart of the Kane-Mele quantum spin Hall insulator, with spin Chern number $1$ or $3$ and spin-carrying monopoles. Chiral states imply Kalmeyer-Laughlin, semion$\times$semion, and three-fermion orders, rotation-breaking ones show $q\to -q$ asymmetric neutron spectra, and sign-alternating fluxes break time reversal alone. Masses and monopoles in these many-flavor phases and the energetics of frustrated SHD Heisenberg models are natural next steps.

AI.tldr: 利用费米子部分子平均场与投影对称群（PSG）系统分类SHD晶格自旋液体，揭示Kitaev液体、临界半狄拉克液体、多味狄拉克液体及DM诱导的自旋量子霍尔态等相。
AI.motivation: SHD晶格既承载精确可解的Kitaev自旋液体，其阻挫Heisenberg磁体又因进一步邻耦合出现经典简并线，量子涨落可融化Néel序；因此需要将该状态置于晶格所有自旋液体中定位。
AI.method: 对单重态和自旋-轨道耦合三重态振幅的费米子部分子平均场态按PSG分类；将SHD的Z2 PSG视为含时间反演的p6mm投影类，并可推广到单轨道p6mm晶格；在理想Kitaev模型及超越Kitaev的模型中分析投影、能带、关联、DM项以及手性和旋转破缺态。
AI.result: 理想Kitaev模型中这些液体继承SU(2) Lieb通量态的单一Z2 PSG且投影为精确本征态；六重旋转符号由十二边形通量固定并使Majorana能带二重化，镜面对称排除均匀场下手性相，仅子格交错三自旋项驱动非阿贝尔Ising相。超越Kitaev发现临界半狄拉克自旋液体（三方向关联r^-3、其余r^-6）、至多48味扩展狄拉克相及PSG禁止所有单重态质量的Nf=12态；面外DM将U(1)类狄拉克态能隙化为Kane-Mele型自旋量子霍尔自旋子对应态（自旋Chern数1或3、带自旋单极子）；手性态对应Kalmeyer-Laughlin、semion×semion和三费米子序，旋转破缺态显示q→-q不对称中子谱，符号交替通量单独破坏时间反演。
AI.conclusion: 该PSG分类给出SHD晶格自旋液体的统一图景，并指出多味相中的质量与单极子以及阻挫SHD Heisenberg模型的能量学是后续自然方向。

title: Transport Signatures of a Kinetically Self-Trapped Nagaoka Polaron
summary: Nagaoka polarons are canonical examples of kinetic magnetism. Although their spin structure is well understood, their transport remains unexplored. We compute the dynamical mobility of a single hole in the square-lattice $t$-model using resummation-based quantum Monte Carlo and analytic continuation. Upon cooling, an incoherent Drude-like response gives way to a finite-frequency peak as the dc mobility vanishes. The peak signals an internal mode of a hole confined by its ferromagnetic cloud. Our results establish transport as an incisive probe of polaron formation and kinetic self-trapping.

AI.tldr: 该文用重求和量子蒙特卡洛和解析延拓计算方格子t模型中单空穴的动态迁移率，揭示Nagaoka极化子的输运特征及其随降温的演化。
AI.motivation: Nagaoka极化子是动能磁性的典型例子，其自旋结构已较清楚，但输运性质尚未被研究；作者旨在把输运作为探测量子极化子形成与动能自陷的敏感手段。
AI.method: 在方格子t模型中计算单个空穴的动态迁移率，采用基于重求和的量子蒙特卡洛方法并结合解析延拓获得实频响应。
AI.result: 降温时，非相干的Drude型响应转变为有限频率峰，同时直流迁移率趋于消失；该峰对应被铁磁云束缚的空穴的内部模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立输运是探测极化子形成和动能自陷的有力探针，并表明Nagaoka极化子的动力学响应具有可辨识的有限频率特征。

title: Field-induced incommensurate--commensurate transitions in anisotropic magnets
summary: We study field-induced incommensurate--commensurate transitions (ICTs) in classical spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) $D$, strong easy-plane anisotropy, and weak easy-axis anisotropy $A$ within the easy plane. This model describes systems with ferromagnetic layers coupled by exchange interaction with DMI. The magnetic field $\bf H$ is applied in the easy plane at an arbitrary angle $\delta$ to the easy axis stabilizing a soliton lattice in the ground state. We consider ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic in-chain exchange interactions within the continuum limit and show that the easy-axis anisotropy leads to qualitatively different effects in these two cases: the ferromagnetic chain is described by a double-sine-Gordon-type equation with phase-shifted harmonics, whereas the antiferromagnetic chain reduces to a sine-Gordon equation. For the latter case, phase boundaries between incommensurate and commensurate states are found analytically in $(H,A,D,\delta)$ space and confirmed by numerical calculations for certain $D$ and $\delta$ values. Close to all ICTs, results of the continuum consideration become invalid due to a stochastic destruction of near-separatrix solutions which either make an ICT a first-order transition or stabilize states with spatially irregular soliton and antisoliton arrangements.

AI.tldr: 该文研究含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、强易面各向异性和面内弱易轴各向异性的经典自旋链中由磁场诱导的不可公度-公度转变（ICT），并比较铁磁与反铁磁链内交换下的连续极限行为。
AI.motivation: 理解易轴各向异性、DMI、面内磁场角度和交换相互作用如何共同决定孤子晶格基态及不可公度-公度相边界，尤其是铁磁与反铁磁链的差异。
AI.method: 在连续极限下处理经典自旋链，考虑铁磁和反铁磁链内交换；磁场加在易面内并与易轴成任意角δ，以稳定孤子晶格；对反铁磁情形解析求相边界并在特定D和δ下数值验证。
AI.result: 易轴各向异性对两类链影响定性不同：铁磁链由具有相位偏移谐波的双正弦-Gordon型方程描述，反铁磁链约化为正弦-Gordon方程；反铁磁情形可在(H,A,D,δ)空间解析得到不可公度与公度相边界，并经数值计算确认。所有ICT附近，近分界线解的随机破坏使连续理论失效，导致一阶转变或空间不规则孤子/反孤子排列。
AI.conclusion: 铁磁与反铁磁链中易轴各向异性导致不同的有效模型和ICT行为；连续极限仅在远离ICT处可靠，近转变处需考虑随机破坏及可能的一阶或无序孤子态。

title: Fractionalized Fermi Liquid and d-wave Superconductivity in Ba2CuO3+x
summary: Strongly enhanced superconductivity (SC) (Tc = 73 K) in Ba2CuO3+x (BCO) challenges the longheld paradigm of the irrelevance of the dz2-like states in cuprates. Using tight-binding band structure plus dynamical mean-field theory (TB+DMFT), we find that a fractionalized Fermi liquid (FFL) is the normal state for the parameters realistic for BCO. Transport properties exhibit strange metal behavior above Tcoh~38 K, supporting a direct instability of this strange metal to SC. Irrelevance of one-fermion inter-band mixing, itself a non-trivial consequence of the FFL state, preferentially enhances two-fermion hopping processes and provides a novel route for both SC and competing excitonic order(s) arising directly from the FFL. The proposed scenario also clarifies the role of dz2 band in shaping the physical responses of BCO.

AI.tldr: TB+DMFT表明Ba2CuO3+x的正常态为分数化费米液体（FFL），奇异金属可直接失稳至Tc=73 K超导；FFL抑制单费米子带间混合并增强双费米子跃迁，为超导与激子序提供统一机制，并阐明dz2带作用。
AI.motivation: Ba2CuO3+x中Tc=73 K的强超导挑战了铜氧化物中dz2类态无关紧要的传统范式，需要阐明其正常态、输运行为与超导机制。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚能带结构结合动力学平均场理论（TB+DMFT），针对BCO实际参数计算正常态与输运性质，并分析带间混合和跃迁过程。
AI.result: BCO实际参数下正常态为分数化费米液体（FFL）；Tcoh~38 K以上输运呈奇异金属行为，支持奇异金属直接失稳到超导；FFL使单费米子带间混合无关紧要，从而优先增强双费米子跃迁，为超导及竞争激子序提供新路径。
AI.conclusion: 该FFL图像可统一解释BCO的强超导、奇异金属输运以及dz2带在物理响应中的作用。

title: Inducing Extraordinary-log Criticality through a Quantum Spin Chain
summary: We demonstrate the emergence of extraordinary-log criticality in a quantum many-body system by coupling a spin-$1/2$ Heisenberg chain to a two-dimensional quantum critical Heisenberg bilayer. Under the quantum-to-classical mapping, the chain acts as a plane defect in a three-dimensional critical environment for which the extraordinary-log universality class has recently been predicted. Using large-scale sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we directly probe the renormalization-group flow of the effective defect coupling through the spin stiffness. We observe the characteristic logarithmic growth with linear system size $L$, corresponding to a stable weak-coupling fixed point and a running coupling $g(L)\sim 1/\log L$. Furthermore, the extracted step-scaling function quantitatively follows the universal renormalization-group flow predicted for the extraordinary-log universality class, including the leading and subleading universal coefficients. Our results establish extraordinary-log criticality in a genuine quantum many-body setting and show that its universal behavior persists despite the topological $\theta$-term present in the low-energy field theory of the isolated spin chain.

AI.tldr: 通过将自旋-1/2海森堡链耦合到二维量子临界海森堡双层，并在量子-经典映射下把链视为三维临界环境中的平面缺陷，利用大规模无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟观测到 extraordinary-log 临界性。
AI.motivation: extraordinary-log 普适类此前主要在理论预言层面，尚缺乏在真实量子多体系统中的实现与验证；本文旨在检验其普适重整化群流，并考察孤立自旋链低能场论中拓扑 θ 项是否破坏该普适行为。
AI.method: 采用量子-经典映射，将一维自旋链视为三维临界环境中的平面缺陷；使用大规模无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟，通过自旋刚度直接探测有效缺陷耦合的重整化群流，并提取跑动耦合 g(L) 与 step-scaling 函数。
AI.result: 观察到随线性尺寸 L 的特征对数增长，对应稳定弱耦合不动点及 g(L)∼1/log L；提取的 step-scaling 函数定量符合 extraordinary-log 普适类预言的普适重整化群流，包括领头与次领头普适系数。
AI.conclusion: 在真实量子多体体系中确立了 extraordinary-log 临界性，并表明其普适行为在孤立自旋链低能场论存在拓扑 θ 项时仍然保持。

title: Equal-spin pairing at finite Cooper-pair momentum in $p$-wave magnets
summary: The realization of Fulde-Ferrell (FF) superconducting states has long been pursued but remains challenging because of the large Zeeman splitting required. Here, we demonstrate that $p$-wave magnets can host equal-spin finite-pair-momentum states with $p$-wave symmetry, termed FF states, at arbitrarily weak fields. Our Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis shows that, owing to the displacement of the Fermi surface, two equal-spin electrons in the FF states pair at the same energy, just as in the opposite-spin zero-pair-momentum states of the same gap symmetry. At zero field, the FF states are therefore exactly degenerate with these zero-pair-momentum counterparts. An arbitrarily weak Zeeman field lifts this degeneracy and makes the FF states the superconducting ground state, since they remain stable owing to their equal-spin nature, whereas their counterparts are suppressed by the formation of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. These findings identify the fermiology of $p$-wave magnets as a promising route toward long-sought finite-momentum superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并论证：p波磁体可在任意弱磁场下实现等自旋、有限配对动量的p波FF超导态，从而为长期难以实现的有限动量超导提供新途径。
AI.motivation: 传统FF超导态需要很大的Zeeman分裂才能稳定，实验实现困难；作者希望利用p波磁体的特殊费米面结构规避这一限制。
AI.method: 基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）分析，研究p波磁体中等自旋电子在有限配对动量下的配对条件，并与同对称性零动量配对态比较能量和稳定性。
AI.result: 由于费米面位移，FF态中的两个等自旋电子可在相同能量配对；零场时FF态与零动量对应态严格简并。任意弱Zeeman场即可解除简并，使FF态成为超导基态：等自旋特性使其稳定，而零动量对应态因Bogoliubov费米面形成而被抑制。
AI.conclusion: p波磁体的费米面性质（fermiology）是实现有限动量超导的有前景路径，并可在极弱磁场下获得稳定的等自旋p波FF态。

title: Scaling of entanglement with distance between subsystems: detection of phase transitions in the $t'$-$\pi$-flux model
summary: The system-size scaling of bipartite entanglement can be used to detect phase transitions. We develop a related approach for strongly correlated electron models where large density matrices or large system size scaling are inaccessible. To this end, we demonstrate that phase transitions of various kinds are signaled by a sharp signature in the first- or second-order logarithmic derivatives of the negativity measuring entanglement between small clusters at varying distances. Crucially, we show how to mitigate the effect of quantum Monte Carlo noise at large distances when computing the negativity. Our focus is on the $t'$-$\pi$-flux Hubbard model using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It has the particular advantage of showing three distinct phase transitions in a single model: semimetal to band insulator, semimetal to antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, and a magnetic order-disorder transition belonging to the Gaussian, Gross-Neveu, and O(3) Wilson-Fisher universality classes, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出利用小团簇间negativity的一阶/二阶对数导数尖锐特征探测强关联电子模型相变，并在t'-π通量Hubbard模型的辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟中识别三类相变。
AI.motivation: 强关联电子模型中大密度矩阵或大系统尺寸标度通常不可得，传统基于二分纠缠系统尺寸标度的相变检测方法受限；需要一种适用于小团簇、且能抑制量子蒙特卡洛噪声的相变探测方案。
AI.method: 计算不同距离小团簇之间的negativity作为纠缠度量，分析其一阶或二阶对数导数的尖锐信号；给出大距离下量子蒙特卡洛噪声的抑制方法；以辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟t'-π通量Hubbard模型。
AI.result: negativity对数导数中的尖锐特征可标记相变；该模型展示半金属到带绝缘体、半金属到反铁磁Mott绝缘体、以及磁有序-无序三类相变，分别属于Gaussian、Gross-Neveu和O(3) Wilson-Fisher普适类。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种在无法进行大系统尺寸纠缠标度时检测强关联电子体系相变并区分普适类的实用方法，尤其适合量子蒙特卡洛计算。

title: Fully Gapped Superconductivity in the Nonsymmorphic Centrosymmetric Superconductor In2Bi
summary: The nature of superconductivity in nonsymmorphic In2Bi remains an open question, with ongoing debate over whether it exhibits conventional (BCS-like) or unconventional superconductivity. Here we report the physical characteristics and superconducting properties of polycrystalline In2Bi. Measurements of electrical resistivity, magnetization, penetration depth, and specific heat demonstrate the superconducting transition temperature about 6 K, with a sharp transition in resistivity (Delta_Tc = 0.1 K) and RRR = 57.32, reflecting the high quality of the sample. The upper critical field Hc2(0) obtained from resistivity and magnetization measurements are in good agreement with each other and are smaller than the Pauli limit, suggesting orbital limited mechanism. The coherence length = 35.43 nm, penetration depth = 101.9 nm and electron-phonon coupling constant = 1.05 suggest strongly coupled type-II superconductivity. For T<Tc, Delta_lambda(T) is best described by an s-wave BCS model and does not have any power law dependency with T, which is expected for a nodeless superconducting order parameter. The superfluid density reveals a fully gapped superconductivity with a gap of 2Delta_0/kBTc = 4.02. In the superconducting state, the electronic specific heat is best described by an s-wave BCS model with a gap of 2Delta_0/kBTc = 4.05. All these results from the present study indicate that In2Bi is a typical type-II,BCS-like, strongly coupled, and fully gapped superconductor in the dirty limit.

AI.tldr: 该文通过多手段实验研究多晶In2Bi的超导性质，表明其是典型II型、BCS-like、强耦合、完全能隙且处于脏极限的超导体，支持常规超导机制。
AI.motivation: In2Bi作为非对称空间群材料，其超导配对机制存在常规BCS-like与非常规超导的争议，需要系统实验判别。
AI.method: 制备多晶In2Bi并测量电阻率、磁化率、穿透深度和比热；提取Tc、RRR、上临界场Hc2(0)、相干长度、穿透深度、电子-声子耦合常数、超流密度及能隙等参数，并与s-wave BCS模型比较。
AI.result: Tc约6 K，电阻转变尖锐（ΔTc=0.1 K），RRR=57.32；Hc2(0)由电阻和磁化测量一致且低于Pauli极限，提示轨道限制；相干长度35.43 nm、穿透深度101.9 nm、电子-声子耦合常数1.05，表明强耦合II型超导；Δλ(T)符合s-wave BCS模型且无幂律依赖，超流密度显示完全能隙，2Δ0/kBTc=4.02；超导态电子比热亦符合s-wave BCS模型，2Δ0/kBTc=4.05。
AI.conclusion: 综合结果表明In2Bi为典型II型、BCS-like、强耦合、完全能隙且处于脏极限的超导体，不支持非常规节点型超导配对。

title: Hidden Staggered Superconducting Order in V2Se2O-Family Altermagnets
summary: $\eta$ pairing describes a staggered superconducting condensate whose order parameter changes sign between neighboring unit cells while maintaining a uniform magnitude. Nearly four decades after its theoretical proposal by C. N. Yang, a material platform for stabilizing $\eta$ pairing has remained elusive. Here, we reveal that altermagnetism, despite being pair breaking for conventional BCS pairing, naturally favors $\eta$-like pairing in V$_2$Se$_2$O-family altermagnets. Their valley-contrasting spin structure gives rise to oppositely spin-polarized, symmetry-related valleys centered at $X=(\pi,0)$ and $Y=(0,\pi)$, which form spin-singlet pairing partners separated by the commensurate momentum $\mathbf Q=(\pi,\pi)$, thereby favoring an $\eta$-like condensate. Self-consistent calculations demonstrate that the resulting $\eta$-like state remains robust over broad variations of chemical potential, hopping parameters, and Fermi-surface topology. To detect this hidden staggered order, we propose a phase-sensitive Josephson measurement with a uniform superconductor, where destructive interference suppresses single-Cooper-pair tunneling while preserving two-Cooper-pair processes. This constitutes a charge-$4e$-like Josephson response despite a bulk condensate composed of charge-$2e$ Cooper pairs, providing a direct phase-sensitive signature of the otherwise elusive $\eta$-like condensate in V$_2$Se$_2$O-family altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并论证V$_2$Se$_2$O族交错磁体可自然稳定杨振宁早年预言的η配对，并给出基于相位敏感约瑟夫森效应的探测方案。
AI.motivation: η配对是一种在相邻晶胞间符号反转、幅度均匀的 stagger 超导凝聚态，理论提出近四十年但缺乏材料平台；本文旨在寻找可稳定η-like配对的体系并解决其探测难题。
AI.method: 通过分析交错磁体的谷对比自旋结构，指出X=(π,0)与Y=(0,π)两个相反自旋极化、对称相关的谷可作为自旋单态配对伙伴，并由共同动量Q=(π,π)联系；结合自洽计算检验稳定性，并提出与均匀超导体构成相位敏感约瑟夫森结的探测方案。
AI.result: 自洽计算表明η-like态在化学势、跃迁参数和费米面拓扑较大变化下仍稳健；所提约瑟夫森测量中单Cooper对隧穿因相消干涉被抑制，双Cooper对过程保留，产生类似charge-4e的约瑟夫森响应，尽管体态仍由charge-2e Cooper对组成。
AI.conclusion: V$_2$Se$_2$O族交错磁体为长期难以实现的η-like超导凝聚态提供了可行平台，且charge-4e-like约瑟夫森响应可作为其直接相位敏感指纹。

title: Type 1.5 vortex bags in single component Ginzburg-Landau models with higher order potentials
summary: We demonstrate the existence of type 1.5 like superconductivity in a single component Ginzburg-Landau model with a higher order potential. The model exhibits two competing superconducting Meissner states (MS), each of which has its own pair of length scales (coherence length and penetration depth). The solutions take the form of bags that contain vortices of one vacuum inside the other. This gives rise to four different types of vortex interaction, where one set of length scales determines vortex interactions inside the bags and the other set between the bags. Hence, within the bag the vortices can repel or attract and the bags themselves can repel or attract depending on the hierarchy of four length scales. When vortices repel within the bag, solutions act similarly to those in type 1.5 multicomponent superconductors, but in a single component system.

AI.tldr: 本文在含高阶势的单分量Ginzburg-Landau模型中证明了类type 1.5超导性的存在：两个竞争的Meissner态各自具有相干长度和穿透深度，并形成包裹另一种真空涡旋的“袋”状解。
AI.motivation: type 1.5超导性通常出现在多分量超导体中；作者试图探究是否可在单一分量系统中通过高阶势和竞争超导真空实现类似物理。
AI.method: 构建单分量Ginzburg-Landau模型并引入高阶势，分析两个竞争Meissner态及其各自的相干长度与穿透深度；构造一种真空中的涡旋嵌入另一种真空的袋状解，并按四个长度尺度的层级分类涡旋与袋之间的相互作用。
AI.result: 模型存在两个竞争Meissner态，每个态有独立的一对长度尺度；袋内涡旋和袋本身均可吸引或排斥，从而产生四类涡旋相互作用。当袋内涡旋相互排斥时，其行为类似多分量type 1.5超导体，但体系仍是单分量。
AI.conclusion: 单分量Ginzburg-Landau模型可通过高阶势和竞争Meissner态实现类type 1.5超导性；其丰富相互作用由四个长度尺度的层级决定，拓展了type 1.5超导范式的适用范围。

title: Low-Cost Third-order Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Method for Excited States Using Tensor Hypercontraction and State-Specific Frozen Natural Orbitals
summary: We have developed a reduced-cost framework for excited-state calculations by combining the state-specific frozen natural orbital (SS-FNO) approach with the third-order algebraic diagrammatic construction [ADC(3)] method and tensor hypercontraction (THC). This strategy enables a systematic and controllable truncation of the virtual orbital space, while significantly lowering the computational scaling through the THC representation of the electron repulsion integrals. The method allows black-box application via adjustable thresholds and includes a perturbative correction that compensates for the truncation error. We have used the CIS(D) method to generate the natural orbitals for the excited states. The performance of the SS-FNO-THC-ADC(3) method is assessed for valence, Rydberg, and charge-transfer excitations. Benchmark calculations demonstrate that the combined approach achieves excellent agreement with the canonical ADC(3) results. The efficiency of the present implementation is demonstrated by calculating the excitation energy of a molecule containing 31 atoms and more than one thousand basis functions.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 SS-FNO-THC-ADC(3) 低成本激发态计算框架，通过冻结自然轨道截断虚空间、THC 降低积分缩放，并用微扰校正补偿截断误差，在大体系上保持与正则 ADC(3) 接近的精度。
AI.motivation: 激发态 ADC(3) 计算成本高，尤其虚轨道空间和电子排斥积分计算成为瓶颈，需要系统性、可控且黑箱化的降成本方案。
AI.method: 将态特定冻结自然轨道（SS-FNO）与三阶代数图解构造（ADC(3)）及张量超收缩（THC）结合；用 CIS(D) 生成激发态自然轨道；通过可调阈值实现系统性虚轨道截断，并引入微扰校正补偿截断误差；THC 表示电子排斥积分以显著降低计算缩放。
AI.result: 在价态、Rydberg 和电荷转移激发上评估，结果与正则 ADC(3) 高度一致；并成功计算含 31 个原子、超过 1000 个基函数的分子激发能，展示实现效率。
AI.conclusion: SS-FNO-THC-ADC(3) 是一种可控、黑箱化且高效的激发态计算方法，可在显著降低成本的同时保持 ADC(3) 精度，适用于较大体系的价态、Rydberg 和电荷转移激发计算。

title: Permutationally Invariant Polynomial Descriptors as Colored Multigraphs
summary: The combinatorial explosion in monomial counts limits the extension of global permutationally invariant polynomial (PIP) potential energy surfaces to larger molecular systems. We use graph-theoretic language to reformulate PIPs as colored multigraphs and develop a series of theoretical and computational tools. First, we introduce an offline PIP generation algorithm whose cost has an upper bound independent of atom count for a fixed degree cutoff and number of element types. Second, we introduce a new online PIP evaluation algorithm, termed tensor-network descent. For the full PIP set through degree $d$ in a system of $M$ atoms, the evaluation complexity for $1\le d\le14$ is $O\!\left(f(d)M^{\left\lfloor(\sqrt{1+8d}+1)/2\right\rfloor}\right)$. At the commonly used cutoff of $d=5$, the online evaluation complexity decreases from the $M^{10}$ scaling of conventional explicit term-by-term computation to $M^3$. Numerical tests using the full PIP set through degree 5 show that our method achieves speedups of several orders of magnitude on most MD17 systems and remains computationally affordable for systems containing more than one thousand atoms. The method has a native tensor form, supports automatic differentiation, and provides a unified theoretical construction of four classes of PIP descriptors defined consistently across systems---global, atom-centered, bond-centered, and cluster-centered---establishing a representation and computational foundation for PIP potentials for large systems and for transfer across systems. Together, these results show that PIPs are neither inherently restricted to small systems nor intrinsically nontransferable.

AI.tldr: 该文用图论将置换不变多项式（PIP）重述为着色多重图，提出离线PIP生成与在线张量网络下降求值算法，将PIP势能面计算扩展到千原子级体系，并统一构造四类PIP描述符。
AI.motivation: PIP的单项链式数量组合爆炸限制了全局置换不变多项式势能面向更大分子体系的扩展；作者旨在从表示与计算两方面突破该瓶颈，并检验PIP是否本质上只能用于小体系或不可迁移。
AI.method: 将PIP重新表述为着色多重图，开发离线PIP生成算法，其在固定截断阶数和元素类型数时成本上界与原子数无关；提出新的在线PIP求值算法“张量网络下降”，对截至d阶的完整PIP集合给出复杂度 O(f(d)M^{floor((sqrt(1+8d)+1)/2)})；方法具有原生张量形式并支持自动微分，同时以一致方式统一构造全局、原子中心、键中心和簇中心四类PIP描述符。
AI.result: 对完整PIP集合，在线求值复杂度随d变化；常用d=5时由传统逐项显式计算的M^10降至M^3。数值测试表明在多数MD17体系上获得数个数量级加速，并对超过一千个原子的体系仍可负担。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明PIP并非天然局限于小体系，也并非本质不可迁移；该工作为大规模体系PIP势及跨体系迁移建立了表示和计算基础。

title: Electrochemical Molecular Dynamics within the Finite-Field Framework
summary: Electrochemical processes at charged interfaces lie at the heart of modern technologies and their continued improvement depends on insights into the relevant atomistic processes. However, the necessary tools to impose constant-voltage conditions in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations typically directly target the electrode charge, making their extension to methods that go beyond an empirical description of metals more cumbersome. In this work, we propose an MD protocol to realize a thermodynamic ensemble in which voltage control is attained, but which is formulated purely within the framework of finite-field simulations in 3D periodic boundary conditions. We show a derivation and implementation of such a control device, which we coin an electrostat, in the ELECTRODE package within LAMMPS. Our simulations systematically benchmark the derived theory against other established approaches, for example, showing its equivalence to a potentiostat, and quantify the importance of properly accounting for ensemble fluctuations. We find that for systems of several thousands of atoms, one obtains the same equilibrium properties with the electrostat as with a simpler constant-field simulation. The difference between the two methods only manifests itself at smaller length scales, thereby establishing practical limits for the inclusion of voltage fluctuations in atomistic simulations of electrochemical systems. The strength of this framework also lies in its simplicity of extension to first-principles ab initio and reactive machine-learning potentials.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在三维周期边界有限场分子动力学中实现电压控制热力学系综的“electrostat”协议，并在LAMMPS的ELECTRODE包中实现和验证。
AI.motivation: 电化学界面原子尺度过程至关重要，但现有恒压MD通常直接控制电极电荷，难以扩展到超越经验金属描述的方法，如第一性原理势。
AI.method: 在有限场模拟和3D周期边界框架内推导并实现电压控制协议electrostat，集成于LAMMPS ELECTRODE包；系统基准测试该理论，与现有方法及potentiostat比较，并分析系综涨落的影响。
AI.result: 数千原子体系中，electrostat与简单恒场模拟得到相同平衡性质；差异仅在更小尺度显现，从而界定将电压涨落纳入原子模拟的实用范围；并证明其与potentiostat等价及正确考虑系综涨落的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架简单且可扩展到第一性原理和反应性机器学习势，为电化学界面恒压模拟提供实用工具，并明确电压涨落影响的尺度限制。

title: Single-electron fluorine bonding. II. Benchmarking Minnesota density functional approximations and popular ab initio methods for binding energies (BEs) and F-bond distances
summary: Companion paper I (Khanal and Arunan, in this issue; arXiv:2610.16629 [physics.chem-ph]) reported reference BEs and F-bond distances for two new databases SEFB-15 (DF$\cdots$CH$_3$) and CSFB-14 (DF$\cdots$NH$_3$). Here, we assess performance of popular ab initio methods (MP2, MP3, MP4(DQ), MP4(SDQ), CCSD, and QCISD) with valence- and full-electron correlation treatments, and sixteen Minnesota DFAs, including M06-2X already assessed in companion paper I. CCSD/AVDZ reproduces reference F-bond distances closely, although BEs predicted by it deviate more. Among the 16 Minnesota DFAs, M08-HX reliably reproduces both reference values for DF$\cdots$CH$_3$ and DF$\cdots$NH$_3$, comparable to M05-2X and M06-2X for DF$\cdots$NH$_3$. Selected meta-GGAs (M06-L, M11-L, and MN15-L) exhibit spurious fractional charge transfer in cationic complexes even at infinite separation, whereas hybrid Minnesota DFAs do not, except M05 and M06 for NH$_3$F$^+\cdots$CH$_3$ and NH$_2$F$_2^+\cdots$CH$_3$. Although M08-HX shows slightly larger monomer delocalization error than M05-2X and M06-2X, it is more reliable for predicting BEs of SEFB complexes, indicating that monomer delocalization error alone does not govern DFA performance. Bader's intermolecular delocalization indices (DIs) further support M08-HX as more reliable than M05-2X and M06-2X for SEFB, while the larger DIs from M05-2X and M06-2X explain the degraded performance of their dispersion-corrected variants for DF$\cdots$CH$_3$, with only a minor impact for DF$\cdots$NH$_3$, highlighting the system-dependent nature of functional delocalization error. Present work reveals that M08-HX is more reliable than M05-2X and M06-2X for open-shell DF$\cdots$CH$_3$ complexes, while all three functionals show comparable reliability for closed-shell DF$\cdots$NH$_3$ complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多种从头算方法与16种Minnesota密度泛函对两个新F键数据库SEFB-15（DF···CH3）和CSFB-14（DF···NH3）的参考结合能与F键距离的再现能力，并分析离域误差与性能关系。
AI.motivation: 伴随论文已给出SEFB-15和CSFB-14的参考结合能及F键距离；本文旨在系统检验常用从头算方法和Minnesota DFAs的可靠性，特别是M06-2X之外的功能，并厘清单体离域误差、分子间离域指数与DFA性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 以参考值为基准，测试MP2、MP3、MP4(DQ)、MP4(SDQ)、CCSD、QCISD在价电子和全电子相关处理下的表现，并评估16种Minnesota DFAs；比较F键距离与结合能，考察阳离子复合物中的虚假分数电荷转移，并用Bader分子间离域指数分析色散校正变体性能差异。
AI.result: CCSD/AVDZ较好再现F键距离但结合能偏差较大；M08-HX对DF···CH3和DF···NH3均较可靠，对DF···NH3与M05-2X、M06-2X相当。M06-L、M11-L、MN15-L等meta-GGA在阳离子复合物中即使无限分离也出现虚假分数电荷转移，多数杂化Minnesota DFAs无此问题，但M05和M06在NH3F+···CH3和NH2F2+···CH3中例外。M08-HX单体离域误差略大，却对SEFB复合物结合能更可靠；Bader离域指数支持M08-HX优于M05-2X和M06-2X用于SEFB，并解释其色散校正变体对DF···CH3性能下降更明显、对DF···NH3影响较小。
AI.conclusion: M08-HX对开壳层DF···CH3复合物比M05-2X和M06-2X更可靠，而三者对闭壳层DF···NH3复合物可靠性相当；单体离域误差本身不足以决定DFA性能，功能离域误差具有体系依赖性。

title: Vibro-polaritonic Raman spectroscopy via cavity Born-Oppenheimer perturbation theory
summary: We derive a vibro-polaritonic Raman activity from third-order cavity Born-Oppenheimer perturbation theory (CBO-PT) accounting for weak interactions between electrons and low-frequency cavity modes in the vibrational strong coupling (VSC) regime. This work extends the recently presented CBO-PT linear response approach [J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2024, 15, 2262-2269] from infrared (IR) to vibro-polaritonic Raman spectroscopy. In a first step, we discuss cavity-induced corrections to the static dipole polarizability tensor, which manifest as molecular and cavity mode contribution determined by the polarization-projected static hyperpolarizability tensor. We then obtain the corresponding vibro-polaritonic Raman activity in double harmonic approximation, which contains molecular, cavity and mixed contributions similar to previously discussed CBO-PT IR intensities. The cavity Raman activity can be interpreted as effective transmission component, which is exclusively determined by the polaritonic Raman response. The methodology and its relation to vibro-polaritonic IR spectroscopy is illustrated for a formaldehyde molecule under VSC. An implementation of the CBO-PT linear response approach for vibro-polaritonic Raman and IR spectroscopies is provided via the open-source Python package CBOvibSpec.

AI.tldr: 该文基于三阶腔Born-Oppenheimer微扰理论（CBO-PT），将近期发展的CBO-PT线性响应方法从红外光谱扩展到振动强耦合（VSC）条件下的振动极化激元拉曼光谱，并给出开源实现CBOvibSpec。
AI.motivation: 现有CBO-PT线性响应方法已用于振动极化激元红外光谱，但尚缺乏对应的拉曼光谱理论描述；需要在弱电子-低频腔模相互作用和VSC框架下建立振动极化激元拉曼活性。
AI.method: 从三阶CBO-PT出发，先讨论腔诱导的静态偶极极化率张量修正，其分子与腔模贡献由偏振投影的静态超极化率张量决定；再在双谐振近似下推导振动极化激元拉曼活性，得到分子、腔及混合贡献，并与CBO-PT红外强度类比。腔拉曼活性可解释为由极化激元拉曼响应决定的有效透射分量。以VSC下甲醛分子为例说明方法及其与振动极化激元红外光谱的关系，并通过开源Python包CBOvibSpec实现CBO-PT线性响应的拉曼与红外光谱计算。
AI.result: 建立了CBO-PT框架下的振动极化激元拉曼活性表达式，明确了腔诱导极化率修正及分子、腔、混合贡献；给出腔拉曼活性的有效透射解释，并在甲醛/VSC体系中展示方法及与红外光谱的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将CBO-PT线性响应光谱学从红外拓展至拉曼，为VSC下振动极化激元拉曼光谱提供理论与计算工具，并发布开源实现CBOvibSpec。

title: Geometry-Dependent Electronic Coupling and Singlet Fission Pathways in Carotenoid Dimers
summary: Using the density matrix renormalization group method, we solve the Pariser--Parr--Pople model of $\pi$-electron systems to determine the character and energies of the low-lying eigenstates of a lycopene dimer comprising two 22-carbon-atom chains. To complement these calculations, we use the molecular-exciton, valence-bond model of polyene systems to derive selection rules governing interchain coupling, which provide a physical framework for interpreting the DMRG results. We find that dimer geometry strongly influences both the character and energetics of the low-lying eigenstates. In vertically stacked dimers, neither the bright-dimer state nor the triplet-pair states contain any interchain charge-transfer (CT) character. In contrast, in slip-stacked dimers, both the bright-dimer state and triplet-pair states do contain interchain CT character. We also find that increasing the interchain coupling preferentially stabilizes states with greater interchain character, leading to a reordering of the low-lying eigenstates. These results have direct implications for energetically possible singlet fission (SF) mechanisms in carotenoid aggregates. For vertically stacked dimers, the only energetically viable pathway identified here proceeds through intermediate intrachain triplet-pair states, whereas slip-stacked geometries allow an additional SF pathway mediated by interchain CT states. Our results establish a direct connection between carotenoid packing geometry, symmetry-controlled electronic coupling, and the energetically accessible pathways for SF.

AI.tldr: 该文用DMRG求解番茄红素二聚体的PPP模型，并结合分子激子/价键模型，揭示堆积几何通过对称性控制的链间耦合决定低能态性质及单线态裂分路径。
AI.motivation: 理解类胡萝卜素聚集体中堆积几何如何影响低能激发态特征、能级顺序以及能量可行的单线态裂分机制。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）求解由两条22碳链组成的番茄红素二聚体的Pariser-Parr-Pople（PPP）模型；同时用聚烯体系的分子激子与价键模型推导链间耦合选择规则，为解释DMRG结果提供物理框架。
AI.result: 垂直堆叠二聚体中，亮二聚体态和三重态对态均无链间电荷转移（CT）特征；滑移堆叠二聚体中二者均具链间CT特征。增大链间耦合会优先稳定链间特征更强的态，导致低能态重排。垂直堆叠仅存在经链内三重态对中间态的能量可行SF路径；滑移堆叠还可经链间CT态介导额外SF路径。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了类胡萝卜素堆积几何、对称性控制的电子耦合与单线态裂分能量可行路径之间的直接联系。

title: Physics-Transfer Learning: A Physics-Constrained Theory for Zero-Shot Generalization Along the Ladder of Complexity
summary: Reliable out-of-distribution generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning, particularly when models are deployed in data-scarce high-fidelity domains. Existing approaches often rely on statistical distribution alignment, or invariance assumptions that can fail when domain shifts reflect changes in underlying mechanisms. Inspired by a longstanding paradigm in physics that understands complex systems by starting from tractable idealizations and progressively incorporating additional mechanisms and levels of fidelity, we propose physics-transfer (PT) learning, a physics-constrained learning theory for zero-shot generalization along a ladder of complexity. PT constructs chains of anchor domains (CADs) that connect low-cost source domains to complex targets and introduces computable feasibility and reliability indicators for assessing transfer before target-domain labels are observed. Under physical-consistency and stable-representation assumptions, we derive an operational upper bound on target risk in terms of source empirical risk, the PT indicators, and finite-sample errors, and establish convergence as adjacent complexity gaps shrink and data coverage improves. We evaluate PT on excited-state energy prediction in quantum systems and dynamical-transition prediction in classical systems using neural networks trained without target-domain labels. Across substantial distribution shifts, PT yields accurate high-fidelity predictions, while the indicators identify incorrect physical mappings before target-domain prediction fails. These results provide a model-agnostic framework for designing, diagnosing, and controlling generalization in data-scarce learning problems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出物理迁移（PT）学习：通过构建连接低成本源域与复杂目标域的锚域链（CADs），在未观测目标标签前评估迁移可行性与可靠性，实现沿复杂度阶梯的零样本OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺的高保真领域中OOD泛化困难；现有统计分布对齐或不变性假设在域偏移源于底层机制变化时容易失效。
AI.method: 受物理学从可解理想化逐步引入机制与保真度的范式启发，PT构建锚域链连接源域与目标域，并引入可计算的可行性与可靠性指标；在物理一致性与稳定表示假设下，给出由源经验风险、PT指标和有限样本误差构成的目标风险上界，并分析复杂度间隙缩小与数据覆盖提升时的收敛性。
AI.result: 在量子系统激发态能量预测和经典系统动力学转移动预测中，仅用无目标标签训练的神经网络在大幅分布偏移下仍能给出准确高保真预测；PT指标可在目标域预测失败前识别错误物理映射。
AI.conclusion: PT提供了模型无关的框架，用于在设计、诊断和控制数据稀缺学习问题中的泛化。

title: Regime-Aware Coupled Orchestration of Neural Operator Specialists for Multiphysics Dynamics
summary: Real-world physics often unfolds over a variety of characteristic lengths and time scales. These non-uniformities are among the main reasons numerical simulations remain expensive when used predictively on practical systems: the same computational domain can contain smooth transport, vortical structures, thin interfaces, reaction fronts, and rapidly relaxing regions. Neural operators are attractive surrogates for such problems. However, a single architecture is still expected to represent all these local behaviours with a single set of weights and a single inductive bias. In this work, we introduce the regime-aware coupled neural orchestrator (RCNO), a framework that learns to distribute and connect a library of local operator specialists in space and time. For every patch, an orchestrator builds a causal query from the current fields, neighbouring halo values, local regime features, patch identity, activity level, and case parameters. The nine expert embeddings exchange two rounds of query-conditioned message passing before an edge-biased cross-attention stage produces a dispatch distribution that can be evaluated sparsely. Local predictions are assembled into a global field and projected onto system-specific physical constraints. A seam-aware extension additionally learns residual corrections across internal patch interfaces. We apply the same orchestration architecture to two qualitatively different systems: reacting flow and Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes (CHNS) dynamics. The results show that useful operator specialisation exists across local regimes, that the advantage of conditional composition increases as the spatial decomposition becomes finer, and, on reacting flow, that explicitly treating patch interfaces improves continuity, PDE consistency, and rollout accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出RCNO（regime-aware coupled neural orchestrator），通过时空编排局部算子专家库来建模多尺度、多区域PDE动力学。
AI.motivation: 真实物理系统包含平滑输运、涡结构、薄界面、反应前沿和快速松弛等非均匀特征；单一神经算子以单套权重和单一归纳偏置难以同时表征这些局部行为，导致预测性数值模拟仍昂贵。
AI.method: 构建局部算子专家库，并在每个patch上由orchestrator基于当前场、邻接halo值、局部regime特征、patch身份、活动水平和算例参数生成因果查询；9个专家嵌入进行两轮查询条件消息传递，再由边偏置交叉注意力产生可稀疏评估的调度分布；局部预测组装为全局场并投影到系统特定物理约束；seam-aware扩展学习内部patch界面残差修正。
AI.result: 在反应流与Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes（CHNS）两类定性不同系统上验证：局部regime间存在有用的算子专门化；空间分解越细，条件组合优势越明显；反应流中显式处理patch界面可提升连续性、PDE一致性和rollout精度。
AI.conclusion: RCNO可作为区域感知、可组合的神经算子代理模型，有效处理多regime、多尺度PDE动力学，并通过稀疏调度与物理约束投影兼顾表达能力和物理一致性。

title: Development of a Particle Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook Method for Rarefied Monatomic Gas Mixtures
summary: The Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) method has long served as a reliable numerical approach for simulating rarefied and non-equilibrium gas flows. Its computational cost, however, increases rapidly as the flow approaches the near-continuum regime. This limitation has motivated the development of kinetic model equations that replace binary collisions with simplified relaxation processes. This paper presents a particle multi-relaxation unified BGK (UBGK) model for monatomic gas mixtures. The model retains pairwise species relaxation and determines the target velocity, temperature, shear stress, and heat flux by matching the corresponding production terms to those of the Boltzmann equation. A stochastic particle algorithm is developed. The model is implemented in SPARTA, and two validation problems are considered: homogeneous relaxation and a Mach 3 flow over a cylinder. In both cases, the UBGK solution reproduces the DSMC reference behavior, including species-dependent relaxation and non-equilibrium shock structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于单原子气体混合物的粒子多松弛统一BGK（UBGK）模型，并开发随机粒子算法、在SPARTA中实现，以降低近连续区流动模拟成本。
AI.motivation: DSMC虽适用于稀薄和非平衡气体流动，但接近连续区时计算成本急剧增加，因此需要以简化松弛过程替代二元碰撞的动理学模型方程。
AI.method: 构建保留组分间成对松弛的粒子多松弛UBGK模型；通过使目标速度、温度、剪应力和热流的产生项与Boltzmann方程对应项匹配来确定模型参数；开发随机粒子算法并集成到SPARTA。
AI.result: 在均匀松弛和Mach 3圆柱绕流两个验证算例中，UBGK结果重现了DSMC参考行为，包括组分相关松弛和非平衡激波结构。
AI.conclusion: 该粒子多松弛UBGK模型可用于单原子气体混合物的稀薄/非平衡流动模拟，并在保持DSMC主要物理特征的同时具备降低近连续区计算成本的潜力。

title: Advanced computational methods for simulating the classical hydrogen atom in stochastic electrodynamics
summary: Stochastic electrodynamics (SED) is a theory of nature that seeks to derive key aspects of quantum mechanics and quantum electrodynamics from a purely classical physics perspective. While SED has been successful in many areas, it has largely failed to stably simulate the 3D classical hydrogen atom. The computational methodology presented here overcomes these foundational challenges. We develop a pseudo-wave formulation that integrates the solid angle in k-space utilizing symmetry, resulting in a significantly reduced memory footprint and lower computational overhead for generating the zero-point radiation spectrum. This optimization is paired with a logarithmic frequency grid, a sliding window tracking the instantaneous Keplerian frequency, and a Tukey smoothing function to eliminate discrete force discontinuities. Integrated via an adaptive RKF45 solver across highly dense grids of up to 100-million bins, these techniques demonstrate the asymptotic convergence of ensemble stability. We show that increasing the grid resolution in the high-frequency domain systematically mitigates artificial electron decay, yielding a simulated probability density function that closely aligns with the quantum mechanical ground state P(r).

AI.tldr: 提出一种伪波公式与数值优化方法，使随机电动力学（SED）能够稳定模拟三维经典氢原子，并得到与量子力学基态概率密度 P(r) 高度一致的结果。
AI.motivation: SED 试图从纯经典物理推导量子力学和量子电动力学关键特征，但长期难以稳定模拟三维经典氢原子；本文旨在克服这一基础性计算挑战。
AI.method: 利用对称性在 k 空间积分立体角，构建伪波公式以降低零点辐射谱生成的内存和计算开销；结合对数频率网格、跟踪瞬时开普勒频率的滑动窗口和 Tukey 平滑函数消除离散力不连续性；使用自适应 RKF45 求解器在高达一亿 bin 的密集网格上积分。
AI.result: 实现了系综稳定性的渐近收敛；提高高频域网格分辨率可系统性减轻人工电子衰减，模拟得到的概率密度函数与量子力学基态 P(r)  closely aligns。
AI.conclusion: 该计算框架克服了 SED 稳定模拟三维经典氢原子的基础难题，并表明在高分辨率数值条件下可复现与量子基态一致的统计分布。

title: An Adaptive-Horizon Graph Neural Operator for coupled surrogate morphodynamic modelling
summary: Morphodynamic simulations require repeated coupling between hydrodynamic solvers, sediment transport modules, and bed updating. For long duration, multi-scenario simulations on large unstructured meshes, such coupling is computationally demanding. This study proposes an Adaptive-Horizon Graph Neural Operator (AH-GNO) that formulates bed evolution as a graph operator learning problem from recent hydrodynamic and topographic states to predict future bed elevation increments. The model operates directly on the native unstructured meshes. The approach integrates area-weighted graph learning, historical state selection, and forecast horizon estimation, allowing the effective history length (K) and update interval (B) to vary with the evolving flow and bed state. Using Telemac2D/GAIA solutions as supervised numerical references, the framework is evaluated on the official Bump and Yen bend benchmarks and on a field-scale application (Waiho River, New Zealand). Results show that the AH-GNO reproduces the main patterns of bedform migration, bend-scale erosion and deposition, and localized bed adjustment. Across the three cases, the tested CPU-GPU deployment reduced post-training bed-update workflow time from 12~1204 s with GAIA to 0.08~3.34 s with AH-GNO. This improvement corresponds to deployment-specific accelerations of approximately 150~360 times relative to 4-core GAIA CPU configurations, and with 105~186 times gains for 20-core CPU configurations. These results suggest that, while retaining hydrodynamic feedback from TELEMAC-2D, a learned operator for bed updating can provide an efficient acceleration component for morphodynamic scenario analysis and rapid coupled simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应时域图神经算子（AH-GNO），将床面演化建模为从近期水动力与地形状态到未来床面高程增量的图算子学习问题，在原生非结构网格上加速形态动力学模拟中的床面更新。
AI.motivation: 形态动力学模拟需反复耦合水动力求解器、泥沙输运模块与床面更新；在大型非结构网格上进行长历时、多情景模拟时计算成本很高。
AI.method: AH-GNO 直接作用于非结构网格，融合面积加权图学习、历史状态选择与预测时域估计，使有效历史长度 K 和更新间隔 B 随流场与床面状态变化；以 Telemac2D/GAIA 解作为监督数值参考，在 Bump、Yen bend 基准及新西兰 Waiho River  field-scale 案例上评估。
AI.result: 模型再现了床形迁移、弯道尺度冲淤和局部床面调整的主要模式；三个案例中，训练后床面更新工作流时间由 GAIA 的 12~1204 s 降至 AH-GNO 的 0.08~3.34 s，相对 4 核 GAIA CPU 加速约 150~360 倍，相对 20 核 CPU 加速 105~186 倍。
AI.conclusion: 在保留 TELEMAC-2D 水动力反馈的同时，学习式床面更新算子可作为高效加速组件，用于形态动力学情景分析与快速耦合模拟。

title: Time-Domain Data-Driven Loewner Reduced-Order Models for Electromagnetic Simulation
summary: This paper presents a data-driven Loewner framework for constructing reduced-order models (ROMs) from time-domain electromagnetic (EM) simulation data. High-fidelity simulation of microwave devices can be computationally expensive, particularly when fine spatial discretization and long observation windows are required. The proposed method uses transient input-output data to construct Loewner and shifted Loewner matrices, from which a reduced descriptor realization is obtained through singular value decomposition (SVD). The resulting models are identified from a limited training window and used to predict responses over substantially longer time intervals, with prediction windows up to 50 times the duration of the training window. The method is formalized as an explicit, reproducible algorithm and validated against full-order simulations for four microwave structures: a substrate-integrated-waveguide filter, a frequency-selective surface, an evanescent-mode coaxial comb-line filter, and a diplexer. The results demonstrate the potential of Loewner-based identification to provide compact models of electromagnetic responses while reducing the need for repeated full-order simulation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于数据驱动的Loewner框架，用于从时域电磁仿真数据构建降阶模型（ROM），并可在远长于训练窗口的时间区间内预测电磁响应。
AI.motivation: 高保真微波器件电磁仿真在精细空间离散和长观测窗口下计算代价高，亟需减少重复全阶仿真并构建紧凑模型。
AI.method: 利用瞬态输入输出数据构造Loewner矩阵与移位Loewner矩阵，通过奇异值分解（SVD）获得降阶描述子实现；方法被形式化为显式、可复现算法，并由有限训练窗口辨识模型后用于更长时间区间预测。
AI.result: 在四个微波结构上对照全阶仿真验证：基片集成波导滤波器、频率选择表面、倏逝模同轴梳状滤波器和双工器；预测窗口可达训练窗口时长的50倍。
AI.conclusion: Loewner-based辨识能够为电磁响应提供紧凑模型，并降低对重复全阶仿真的需求。

title: Managing complexity for integrated fusion reactor design using a differentiable graph-based MDAO framework: PROCESS as a case study
summary: Integrated design of nuclear fusion reactors requires combining an increasingly large number of models from different disciplines self-consistently, with model selection and parametrisation changing between design studies. Manual definition of execution order and solvers for cyclic dependencies is error-prone, inefficient, and inflexible. We propose to use a generic graph-based coordination and execution core that enables automated execution order, cycle detection, and solver architecture specification for any set of models or parametrisation. To this end, a computational dependency graph of purely functional models is extended by a conditional node and nesting edges, treating solvers and optimisers in the same way. A minimal set of graph operations then allows for fine-tuned control on feedback resolution, making both optimiser and solver architectures easily reconfigurable. Existing monolithic multidisciplinary design analysis and optimisation (MDAO) architectures can be recovered by sequentially applying these operations. The cottax package implements this extended dependency graph, graph operations, executability checks, and a JAX-based execution layer. This execution layer eliminates runtime overhead and provides native gradient computation through the whole graph. As a proof of principle, cottax is then applied to the PROCESS systems code. Graph sequencing shows that for PROCESS only three small coupled components need to be solved every optimiser iteration. Monolithic MDAO architectures are then assigned to seven different PROCESS configurations, demonstrating the ease of (re)configuring its architecture. Compared to PROCESS, the sequencing and execution back-end together yield a two to three orders of magnitude reduction in model runtime during optimisation. cottax is currently being considered as the basis for developing an integrated stellarator MDAO framework.

AI.tldr: 提出基于通用计算依赖图的协调与执行核心 cottax，用于聚变堆多学科 MDAO 的自动化排序、循环检测和求解器/优化器架构配置，并在 PROCESS 系统代码上验证显著加速。
AI.motivation: 聚变堆集成设计需自洽耦合大量跨学科模型，且模型选择与参数化随设计研究变化；手动定义执行顺序和循环依赖求解器易错、低效且不灵活。
AI.method: 将纯函数模型的计算依赖图扩展为带条件节点和嵌套边的图，把求解器与优化器统一处理；用最小图操作集细粒度控制反馈求解，并可顺序组合恢复现有单体 MDAO 架构。cottax 实现扩展依赖图、图操作、可执行性检查及基于 JAX 的执行层，支持全图原生梯度并消除运行时开销。
AI.result: 在 PROCESS 上验证：图排序表明每次优化迭代仅需求解三个小型耦合组件；可为七种 PROCESS 配置分配单体 MDAO 架构，显示架构易重配置；排序与执行后端结合使优化期间模型运行时间降低两到三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: cottax 提供了可自动化、可重配置的 MDAO 协调执行基础，并正被考虑作为集成仿星器 MDAO 框架的开发基础。

title: PINN-LPCDD: Physics-Informed Neural Network with Learnable and Physically Consistent Domain Decomposition for Compressible Multi-Medium Flows
summary: The physics-informed neural network (PINN) faces significant challenges when solving compressible multi-medium flows, including the inability to locate interface positions, poor approximation of discontinuities, and difficulty in handling high-pressure-ratio problems between media with large stiffness differences. To address these issues, we propose PINN with Learnable and Physically Consistent Domain Decomposition (PINN-LPCDD), a framework that incorporates the sharp interface method (SIM) into PINNs for solving compressible multi-medium flows. Firstly, we design separate sub-networks for each medium with learnable parameters to automatically learn interface positions, so that the domain decomposition is physically consistent, and the contact discontinuity at the interface is naturally sharp. Secondly, the Euler equations with artificial viscosity are solved to enhance robustness when handling problems involving shock waves. Lastly, the scaling invariance of the Euler equations is exploited to facilitate the solution of high pressure ratio problems. Numerical experiments on air-air, air-helium, air-water, and air-R22 problems demonstrate the acceptable accuracy of the proposed method in simulating multi-medium flows.

AI.tldr: 提出PINN-LPCDD框架，将锐界面方法引入物理信息神经网络，用于求解可压缩多介质流动，实现界面位置自动学习与物理一致的区域分解。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在可压缩多介质流动中难以定位界面、逼近间断，且对介质间大刚度差异导致的高压比问题处理困难。
AI.method: 为每种介质设计独立子网络并引入可学习参数以自动学习界面位置，使区域分解物理一致且界面接触间断保持锐利；采用含人工黏性的Euler方程增强激波鲁棒性；利用Euler方程的尺度不变性处理高压比问题。
AI.result: 在空气-空气、空气-氦气、空气-水和空气-R22数值实验中，方法在多介质流动模拟中表现出可接受的精度。

title: Foundation-Model Supervision of Distilled Potentials for Million-Atom Molecular Dynamics
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials distilled from foundation models enable fast large-scale molecular dynamics (MD), but they can fail locally in chemical environments that their training data did not sample. System-averaged error metrics and small random audits often miss such sparse or isolated failures. Here we use an exact equivariant foundation model, MACE-MPA-0, to check every atom of million-atom production simulations. Reorganizing two-layer MACE inference into a receiver-chunked three-pass schedule that keeps no per-edge intermediates resident reduces the marginal memory per atom 340-fold, evaluates up to $2.86\times10^{7}$ atoms on a single H200 GPU, and supervises $10^{6}$-atom trajectories in LAMMPS at 1.3% of the run time. Distilled MACE students run four to nine times slower than NEP89 with 0.95-1.28 times the teacher's force error against density functional theory (DFT). In molten SiO$_2$, whole-system checks uncover a persistent tail of under-coordinated atoms hidden by the system-averaged error and an isolated, unphysical O-O contact that a 1% random audit misses 94% of the time. On-the-fly retraining on teacher-labelled 13-{\AA} clusters, with the force loss restricted to their inner 6 {\AA}, removes three quarters of the failure tail and the kilobar-level pressure biases in SiO$_2$ and compressed water; the repair converges to the teacher, not to DFT.

AI.tldr: 该工作用精确等变基础模型 MACE-MPA-0 对百万原子级 MD 的每个原子进行全系统监督，以低成本发现并修复蒸馏势在稀疏局部化学环境中的隐蔽失效。
AI.motivation: 从基础模型蒸馏得到的机器学习原子间势虽能加速大规模 MD，但在训练数据未覆盖的局部化学环境中可能失效；系统平均误差和小比例随机审计常漏掉稀疏或孤立故障。
AI.method: 将两层 MACE 推理重组为接收端分块的三遍调度，不保留逐边中间量，使每原子边际内存降低 340 倍，单张 H200 GPU 可评估至多 2.86×10^7 个原子，并在 LAMMPS 中以 1.3% 运行时间监督 10^6 原子轨迹；随后用教师标注的 13 Å 团簇进行在线重训练，力损失仅限制在内层 6 Å。
AI.result: 蒸馏 MACE 学生模型比 NEP89 慢 4–9 倍，对 DFT 的力误差为教师的 0.95–1.28 倍。在熔融 SiO2 中，全系统检查发现系统平均误差掩盖的持续欠配位原子尾部和孤立非物理 O–O 接触，后者有 94% 概率被 1% 随机审计漏掉。在线重训练消除了四分之三的失效尾部及 SiO2 和压缩水中的千巴级压力偏差，且修复收敛到教师而非 DFT。
AI.conclusion: 全原子教师监督使大规模 MD 中的局部失效可检测、可修复，但蒸馏修复继承的是教师模型而非 DFT 真值。
